id.description: Pack id (conventionally the providing module id).

referenceGridSize.description: Grid size (px per square) the stamp pixel sizes were authored at.

perspective.description: How the image is drawn: orthographic (straight down), isometric (three-quarter, depth, no vanishing point), front (a level elevation from the front or side) or central (one-point perspective).

provenance.description: Where every variant’s image came from: one origin per stamp.

source.description: Where it came from: the pack’s own repository for art made for it, or the provider ("Poly Haven", "ambientCG", "Kenney", "Freesound").

license.description: Its licence, as an SPDX id ("CC0-1.0").

author.description: Its author, or who made AI-generated art available.

url.description: Its source page: the pack’s own repository for art made for it.

ai.description: Whether it is AI-generated, whatever its source: art made for the pack, or brought in from elsewhere.

style.description: How its art is made: painted, photorealistic, hand-drawn, flat, pixel-art or line-art.

role.description: What the map composer uses it as. Omitted, its tags say (a stamp tagged `console` is a console); null, it is never composed, however it is tagged (an L-shaped counter no wall takes). A stamp neither names nor tags as anything is only placed by hand.

habitats.description: The ground a land stamp belongs on; the composer dresses each outdoor zone only with stamps of its habitat. Empty, its tags say (`cave`, `ice`, `forest`), else its role’s usual ground.

against.description: Where the composer stands it: with its back (see `back`) against a wall, in a corner, or anywhere free.

clearance.description: Grid squares of open floor the composer keeps in front of it: a counter’s serving side, a hearth’s apron.

back.description: The edge of the image that is the piece’s back, set against a wall or turned away from a table: a bed drawn with its headboard on the left says left. For a defence (an emplacement, a barricade), the side away from the enemy: its front faces out.

upright.description: Drawn side-on or front-on (a tower, a tent, a silo): the composer never turns it, so it always stands as drawn.

placement.description: How the map composer places the stamp, where this image differs from its role’s way (a role’s pieces stand against a wall, face out, or stand upright as the role does). Omitted fields take the role’s.

ways.description: Overrides the stamp’s ways in; null for none in this variant (its ramps raised).

x.description: Where it is on the image, a fraction of its width from the left.

y.description: A fraction of its height from the top.

width.description: How wide it is, a fraction of the image’s width.

state.description: Display label for this variant, e.g. "intact", "open", "lit".

image.description: Image path relative to the pack module root. GPU-compressed art (.ktx2, .basis) is drawn by the canvas, which browsers cannot show as an image, so give it a preview.

preview.description: A browser image (PNG, WebP, ...) the stamp browser and the tile HUD show for compressed art; left out, they show the image.

width.description: Pixel width at the pack referenceGridSize.

height.description: Pixel height at the pack referenceGridSize.

resolution.description: The variant image's long side, rounded to the nearest step (32 to 8K).

anchor.description: The point of the image, as fractions of it (0,0 its top-left), that stands on the stamp's placed point and stays there as variants switch: a ramp or drawbridge lowered from its hinge, its hinge edge's middle. Omitted: the image's centre.

doorState.description: Door state this variant represents (door stamps).

light.description: Overrides the stamp light; null means this variant emits none (e.g. "unlit").

dim.description: Dim light radius, in grid units.

bright.description: Bright light radius, in grid units.

offset.description: Emitter position as a fraction of the footprint (default: centre).

negative.description: A darkness source rather than a light.

darkness.description: The scene darkness range the light is active in, 0 to 1 (a lamp that lights only at night: min 0.5). Foundry's default: always.

hidden.description: Placed hidden from players, for the GM to reveal.

anyOf.description: A native ambient light emitted by the placed stamp.

shape.description: How the stamp is wrapped in native walls: not at all, its bounding box, or its traced alpha silhouette.

sight.description: How the generated walls restrict sight.

light.description: How the generated walls restrict light.

sound.description: How the generated walls restrict sound.

direction.description: A one-way wall: which side it restricts from (Foundry `dir`), walking the outline clockwise.

threshold.description: Distances (grid units) for proximity and distance senses.

attenuation.description: Light and sound fade through the wall with distance.

height.description: Height above the stamp base, in grid units (cover and elevation bands).

cover.description: Cover density: 0 none, 0.5 half, 0.75 three-quarter, 1 full.

blocksMovement.description: Tokens cannot move through the stamp footprint.

particles.description: Overrides the stamp particles; null means none (a "destroyed" variant can smoke).

textures.description: Particle images, relative to the pack module root; each particle takes one at random.

x.description: Emitter centre as a fraction of the footprint width.

y.description: Emitter centre as a fraction of the footprint height.

radius.description: Spawn radius in grid units; 0 is a point.

count.description: How many particles are alive at once.

angle.description: Direction in degrees, clockwise from east (the stamp rotation is added).

fade.description: Fade-in and fade-out, in milliseconds (or a fraction of lifetime when below 1).

elevation.description: Height above the stamp base, in grid units.

provenance.description: Where its particle images came from.

source.description: Where it came from: the pack’s own repository for art made for it, or the provider ("Poly Haven", "ambientCG", "Kenney", "Freesound").

sound.description: Overrides the stamp sound; null means silent.

door.description: The stamp is a door: placing it on a wall makes that wall a Foundry door.

direction.description: Which level(s) the stamp leads to.

movement.description: Movement actions that use it (walk, climb, fly, ...); omitted means any. Stairs are walked, ladders climbed.

transition.description: The stamp moves tokens between elevation levels.

enterable.description: Can open into a linked interior scene (submap).

ways.description: Its ways in drawn on the art (a vehicle’s ramps, a building’s doors): gaps in its walls, and its entrances where it is linked to an interior.
